description: Pick a lane . Make a choice . Stop flip flopping and see it through #careeradvice #communicationskills #leadershipskills
transcript: Pick a lean and stay in it. Pick one thing and allow all the things that you enjoy to contribute to it. Allow the things that you love to build upon it. But pick one thing and make that your focus develop that. There is something about choosing something and seeing it through to the end, no matter how difficult it becomes. I have learned the power of agility.
